gameplaySource.game: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons
gameplaySource.rights: Use brief transformed excerpts with original commentary. Credit LongplayArchive, Terua and the original upload in both descriptions. The retained video-only clips carry no game audio.
gameplaySource.format: The recorder-published format 308 directly decodes as 1600×1440 at the original 10:9 Game Boy Color image aspect, square pixels and zero audio streams. The source clips were copied without resizing or frame conversion. Capture hardware and the pre-upload raster are not disclosed.

observed.before: HUD key count is 0. Link approaches the floor switch in the upper-right part of the room at local PTS 108508 ms.
observed.action: Link reaches the switch and a small key appears on the floor. The key is visible at local PTS 110015–111003 ms.
observed.result: The key is gone at PTS 111505 ms and the HUD shows key count 1. Link subsequently leaves through the already open left passage.
observed.annotation: Follow the floor key while visible, then call out the key count. Do not imply that the first pickup opened the left passage.

observed.before: Link approaches the right-hand door by water. The keyhole and HUD key count 2 are both visible at local PTS 11016–11502 ms.
observed.action: The locked door opens. At local PTS 12004 ms the HUD shows 1 and the key animation is visible at the doorway.
observed.result: Link crosses into the adjoining room by PTS 13008 ms. The HUD still shows 1.
observed.annotation: Track the actual right door only until the camera scrolls, then show the route change and the decremented HUD count.

interveningChronology.evidence: The route survey shows another small-key pickup around local PTS 66015 ms and HUD count 2 before the later lock. Identify the two displayed action excerpts as separated in the original run. Avoid implying they are an uninterrupted route or that the individual keys are distinguishable.

gameplaySource.cropAndCaption: Retain the square-pixel 10:9 source as a proportional inset. Do not stretch it to a vertical canvas or hide the key counter. Synchronize key and door callouts with the observed frames after actual narration timing.

exampleCount.basis: Nintendo official game catalogue. With one verified and adopted game, keep one Nintendo example.

gameplaySource.selectionReason: Keep the exact reference dungeon. The preceding 02.05 footage uses first-person supply and a side-scrolling player map. This episode uses a different top-down key-and-door mechanism. The Boss Keys lesson is research only.

authoredComparison.renderer: Editable Motion Canvas diagram source. Carry its fixed rooms into a later Unity traversal.
authoredComparison.result: With the key in the goal room, all accessible rooms are exhausted before the gate. With the key in the reachable side room, the route returns through the junction and opens the gate once.
authoredComparison.reviewLimits: Both static layouts were inspected at 1080px and 375px. The authored state graph verifies logical reachability. Unity traversal, moving annotations and encoded captions remain separate.

p06Complement.status: Combat-condition recording not yet verified for this episode.
p06Complement.rule: Use only actual evidence of a condition visibly gating later progress. Keep the explanatory example schematic while that evidence is pending.
